description: One technology from the timeline in full, as its page /timeline/<slug>/ shows it: when Jonas used it (period, in use or phased out), the longer text when there is one, world facts (introduced, maker, discontinued), what it replaced and what replaced it, the blog posts and updates about it, the games it inspired, and its release, support and end-of-life dates from the tech calendar. Those posts and updates are already included, so there is no need to call search_updates or list_posts for the same technology. Find slugs with timeline (query), or pass a name such as "Laravel".

slug.description: Row slug as returned by timeline, e.g. "laravel". A name such as "Laravel" (any case) also works. Max 80 characters.

name: get_technology
title: Get one technology
